mapper.insert: insert into portfolio (skiller_id, title, category_id, cover_url, work_urls, description, status, audit_opinion, auditor_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{skillerId}, #{title}, #{categoryId}, #{coverUrl}, #{workUrls}, #{description}, #{status}, #{auditOpinion}, #{auditorId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from portfolio where skiller_id = #{skillerId} order by create_time desc
mapper.update: update portfolio set status = #{status}, audit_opinion = #{auditOpinion}, auditor_id = #{auditorId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from portfolio where id = #{id} and skiller_id = #{skillerId}
